<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/apps/{app-slug}/builds/{build-slug}/log/summary"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Get the workflows and steps of a build with their status, timing and versions. For failed or aborted steps, `errors` holds why the step failed; for skipped steps, `status_reason` holds why it was skipped. The summary is updated as steps finish, so it can be polled while the build is running.
